title: Music Makes a Face

title: Music in the Park

title: Weather Music Match

title: Music Moments Check

title: Animal Song Builder

title: Hill Song Melody

title: Echo Me

title: Practice and Share Stars

title: Friendly Listener
students: Draw one thing you liked about a classmate's song and circle one idea: louder, slower or add a move.

title: Kindergarten Music Picture Review

title: Ta and Ti-Ti Picture Rhythms

title: Stick Note Trace and Clap

title: Pat the Beat, Clap the Words

title: Rhythm Detective

title: Animal Name Rhythm Train

title: Steady Beat Practice Chart

title: Rhythm Round-Up

title: Parts of a Violin

title: Blow, Buzz, Bow or Hit?

title: Family Sound Secret Word

title: Instrument Families Check

title: Music at a Celebration
students: Look at 4 celebration pictures (parade, wedding, festival, ball game) and draw an instrument you might hear at each.

title: Morning Sun, Evening Moon
students: Listen to Morning Mood from Peer Gynt and a lullaby, circle the sun or moon for each, and draw what the music shows.

title: Why I Like It Song Card
students: Pick a favorite class song and circle 2 reasons (beat, words, loud parts, high parts), then draw it.

title: Class Song Picture Graph

title: Moment Music Review

title: Two Stars and a Wish

title: Make It Better
students: Circle one change to improve your song (louder ending, new word, added clap), then draw your new version.
